stories.headline: GTA 6 sold an estimated 47.8 million copies in four days
stories.summary: Sensor Tower data: 35.3M by end of launch day, 47.8M by Sunday — the best-selling game of 2026 in four days, installed on ~35% of active PS5 and Xbox Series consoles. Call of Duty's daily players fell 46% in the same window.

stories.headline: Huawei convicted in US criminal trial over Iran business and trade-secret theft
stories.summary: A Brooklyn jury found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts, including bank fraud, wire fraud, sanctions violations and conspiring to steal trade secrets. Sentencing is set for Sept 14, 2027; Huawei plans to appeal.

stories.headline: Tidal to ban AI-generated music and remove 29 million tracks
stories.summary: Starting Dec 9, Tidal will remove fully AI-generated tracks — about 29 million songs — and reject 80,000–85,000 new ones a day. 43% of tracks uploaded in the last 90 days were flagged as AI-generated.

stories.headline: Dutch AI chip startup Axelera seeks $400M in new funding
stories.summary: Axelera AI is in talks to raise $400M for AI inference chips and is seeking EU grants; meanwhile AI adoption is cutting graduate hiring for clerical roles in Japan, and India's AI sector drew $1.6B in venture funding in 2026's first nine months.

stories.headline: GPT-6 is learning to design proteins in the lab
stories.summary: OpenAI showed GPT-6 models designing protein structures and sequences with reasoning and code alone, with lab validation on five targets. Also: amateur astronomers used AI to spot possible exoplanets in NASA telescope data.

stories.headline: Israel struck Gaza City, killing Hamas's internal security chief
stories.summary: Israel struck Gaza City, killing Naim Abu Nakhla, head of Hamas's internal security apparatus; Gaza authorities have recorded at least 1,679 deaths since the October ceasefire agreement.
